title: Ghostly Captain
description:
Name: [Captain Cornelia](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/cornelia.png:150:150)
Known Locations: Unknown, last seen sailing towards the frozen ocean.
Estimated Size: Medium
Behavior: Capable of using multiple weapons. When driven into a corner, can summon The Shipbreaker. Heavily resistant to all weapons unrelated to the Ice Maze and can only be killed if weakened at low health.
Danger Level: §8§lHard
